out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. A COFFEE MUG WITH COFFEE INSIDE AND A SLEEVE OF COOKIES WERE BEING STORED ON THE CUTTING BOARD OF THE 2DR NORLAKE PREP TOP UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL DRINKS NEED BOTH A LID AND A STRAW TO PREVENT POTENTIAL CONTAMINATION. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE THE COFFEE MUG AND SLEEVE OF COOKIES TO THE OFFICE.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 3DR Turbo Air prep top and 2DR UCR at the pizza making station did not have thermometers.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT ALL UNITS MUST HAVE A THERMOMETER INSIDE TO MAKE SURE IT IS HOLDING THE CORRECT TEMPERATURE. PIC TOLD EHS THAT THEY WILL MAKE SURE ALL UNITS HAVE THERMOMETERS BY NEXT INSPECTION.
